fields.atlas_digest: string — content digest; rows are only comparable at equal digest
fields.atlas_version: string — the atlas release this row came from
fields.caught_by: string|null — the check that is supposed to reject it
fields.defect: string|null — defect key; null for valid cases
fields.title: string|null — one-line description of the mutation
fields.valid: bool — whether a correct verifier should ACCEPT this artifact
fields.why_it_looks_valid: string|null — why a naive verifier would accept it
